primary.root_cause: The RTL concatenates 8 fill bits with the full 24-bit s_axis_data, leaving m_axis_data[23] as s_axis_data[23] instead of the computed fill_bit.
primary.proposed_fix: Change the concatenation to {9{fill_bit}, s_axis_data[22:0]} to correctly place the sign/inverted bit at position 23 and extend it to bits 31:24.

alternative.root_cause: The s_axis_ready signal is assigned combinationaly, bypassing the required pipeline register stage and violating AXI-Stream back-pressure handshake conventions.
evidence: maintaining a single pipeline register stage
alternative.proposed_fix: Register the s_axis_ready output using a flip-flop synchronized to clk and resetn, or tie it to a constant 1'b1 if back-pressure is not supported.
